name: @pipeworx/mcp-numverify

tools.name: numverify_validate
tools.description: Validate a phone number and look up its carrier, line type (mobile/landline), country, and location. Returns international/local formats too. Accepts E.164 (e.g. "+14158586273") or a local number with country_code. Example: numverify_validate({ number: "14158586273", _apiKey: "your-key" })

number.description: Phone number to validate. E.164 like "+14158586273" or "14158586273", or a local number when country_code is supplied, e.g. "4158586273".

country_code.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "US", "GB") — required only when `number` is in local/national format rather than international.

_apiKey.description: Numverify/APILayer API key. Free signup at https://numverify.com/product; key is on your APILayer dashboard.

tools.name: numverify_countries
tools.description: List the countries supported by Numverify, with their ISO country code, name, and international dialing prefix. Example: numverify_countries({ _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Numverify/APILayer API key. Free signup at https://numverify.com/product; key is on your APILayer dashboard.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-numverify forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the numverify pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
